claim: Let \(r\) be the order-eight automorphism \(u_i\mapsto u_{i+1}\), \(v_i\mapsto v_{i+1}\) of the Möbius–Kantor graph \(M=G(8,3)\). As \(\mathbb Q[C_8]\)-modules, \(H_3(\operatorname{Ind}(M);\mathbb Q)\cong \mathbf 1\oplus\varepsilon\oplus V_4\) and \(H_4(\operatorname{Ind}(M);\mathbb Q)\cong\varepsilon\), where \(\varepsilon(r)=-1\) and \(V_4\) is the two-dimensional rational irreducible on which \(r\) has minimal polynomial \(x^2+1\). Equivalently, for \(k=0,\ldots,7\), the two characters on \(r^k\) are \((4,0,0,0,4,0,0,0)\) and \((1,-1,1,-1,1,-1,1,-1)\), respectively.
integrity: The module characters are derived from exact signed chain traces, a complete integral Morse certificate for the homology support, and independent modulo-\(3\) and modulo-\(5\) checks of the rank-one \(H_4\) action. No finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the rational homology action of the canonical rotation subgroup \(C_8\), not the full automorphism-group representation. The closest same-object 2019 source was only partially inspectable through indexed text, leaving a bounded residual originality risk.
title: Cyclic symmetry on Möbius–Kantor independence homology
